description: Where the labels are written, and there are a great many. A typewriter, a card index, a guillotine, and a rack of half-finished cases. Boxes on the floor holding objects that have not been catalogued yet, each with a slip in it saying where it came from and who brought it, which is the part of the record that is scrupulous and true. On the wall, a map of the basin with pins in it, and beside each pin a number that refers to a card in the index.
name: Past Perfect — The Workroom
